revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_014
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the fourteenth and highest steps tier, planetary walking legend theme.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal; uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular cream paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, pencil outline and watercolor texture. Center elements: small soft watercolor planet patch, looping route line around it, bold dark sage footprints, compass rose, tiny orbit dots and leaves. No people, no animals.
Style/medium: cozy TripPet watercolor scrapbook collectible, hand-painted, low-saturation with clear contrast, fine pencil linework, polished mobile game asset.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, readable at small UI size.
Color palette: ivory base, dusty blue planet, muted sage footprints and land shapes, warm ochre compass, coral route dots. Avoid pure #00ff00 in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
